summary: Local snapshot intake audit. It separates the loader path from canonical public model identity so a reviewed mounted snapshot can be used without overwriting the official HF model id in trace provenance.

operator_contract.why: from_pretrained may load from a local path, but public evidence should retain the immutable public model identifier and commit in provenance.

online_source_basis.fact: snapshot_download can filter files with allow_patterns and can download to a local_dir.
HF_HUB_CACHE and HF_HOME define local cache locations for models and snapshots.
from_pretrained accepts attn_implementation and backends are explicitly selectable.
